description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade operations in an embedded Linux environment, such as checking images, copying configuration, upgrading bootloader, and performing system upgrades.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of a given system image, compares partition tables, and prompts for user action if differences are detected.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to a mounted partition.

methods.name: platform_do_bootloader_upgrade
methods.description: Upgrades the system's bootloader (e.g., GRUB) on a specified disk device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a full system upgrade, including writing a new image to the disk, updating UUIDs, and regenerating bootloader configs.
